message.content: {"base_author": ["Sookman's blog post opens with a blast at Professor Geist: 'his attacks use exaggeration, misleading information and half truths to achieve his obvious ends'.", "The court accepted amendments to the case and its submission, as Professor Geist asserts, on October 6.", "The previously mentioned submissions by the heads of CMRRA and SODRAC were indeed actions within the past year; that of SODRAC's Alain Louzon being January 28 this year."]}
